benefitSummary: ₹50,000 per year for every year of study credited directly via DBT for girl students in Diploma or Degree (Engineering, Pharmacy, Management, Computer Applications).
Central Government credits up to ₹78,000 direct subsidy into your bank account within 30 days of rooftop solar installation + gives 300 units/month free power (amortized ₹33,600/yr benefit).
Registered labour card holders unlock 12+ hidden cash payouts: ₹60,000 for marriage (self or 2 children), ₹11,000–₹30,000/yr children's scholarship, ₹50,000 maternity cash, and free toolkits.
Start any small shop, service unit (up to ₹20L), or manufacturing unit (up to ₹50L) and the Government pays 25% to 35% of the project cost as a FREE grant you never have to repay.
1st-year Degree, Engineering, Polytechnic, and Medical students admitted through Govt Quota / CET from low-income families receive a free laptop or ₹35,000 DBT grant.
For street vendors, tea stalls, vegetable sellers, tailors, and small kiosk owners: ₹10k–₹50k zero-collateral capital + 7% interest grant credited to bank + ₹1,200/yr UPI cashback.
₹2,000 every month (₹24,000/year) transferred directly into the bank account of the woman head of the family, plus free non-AC bus travel across the state under Shakti.
100% free household electricity up to 200 units per month (saves ~₹14,400/year in cash for a typical family; tenants can also claim using rental agreement).
5 kg free foodgrains per member under PMGKAY + ₹170/month per member direct bank cash transfer (approx ₹10,200/yr for a family).
₹22,000/year tuition fee reimbursement + maintenance allowance credited straight to student's bank account.
₹12,000–₹20,000/yr scholarship PLUS a hidden gem: under PM-USP CSIS, the Central Govt pays 100% of the interest on education loans up to ₹10 Lakh during the entire study + moratorium period!
₹1,500/month for 10 months (₹15,000/yr) for day-scholar/PG students + government college fee reimbursement.
₹3,000/month (₹36,000/year) for unemployed Degree graduates and ₹1,500/month for Diploma holders for up to 2 years until employed.
₹15,000 free e-voucher for modern tools (sewing machine, carpenter/mason/mechanic kit) + ₹500/day training stipend (~₹3,500) + collateral-free ₹1L–₹3L loan at 5% interest.
₹6,000/year in 3 equal installments of ₹2,000 transferred directly into Aadhaar-seeded bank account.
Small and marginal farmers (1.5 to 5 acres) get a 100% government-funded irrigation borewell, pump set, and ₹75,000 electricity connection worth ₹3.5L–₹4.75L (amortized ₹35,000/yr value).
Up to 60% government grant on solar irrigation pumps (saves ~₹45,000/yr in diesel and electricity expenses).
Government pays ~85% of premium; farmer pays only 1.5%–2% for full financial payout on drought, flood, or pest loss.
Working capital up to ₹3 Lakh at just 4% effective interest (Govt pays 3% interest subvention bonus on timely repayment, saving ~₹15,000/yr; also open to dairy & fishery farmers).
₹1,200/month (₹14,400/year) lifetime monthly pension credited straight to bank or post office account for seniors 60+.
₹1,200/month (₹14,400/year) direct monthly pension for widows from low-income households.
₹5,000 cash transfer for first child and ₹6,000 lump sum for second girl child under PMMVY 2.0 directly to mother's bank account.
₹1,20,000 (Rural PMAY-G) to ₹2,50,000 (Urban PMAY-U 2.0) direct grant in 3–4 geo-tagged installments to build a pucca house (amortized ~₹30,000/yr value).
₹5,00,000/year free cashless treatment at 29,000+ public & private hospitals—PLUS a hidden gem: every senior citizen aged 70+ now gets ₹5L free cover regardless of rich/poor income status!
commonRejectionTrap: Applying under general NSP tab instead of 'AICTE Pragati' section on scholarships.gov.in.
Installing panels through unverified local contractors instead of MNRE portal-registered vendors.
Failing to renew the Labour e-Shram / KBOCWWB card once a year or applying >6 months after marriage/admission.
Applying for a working-capital-only trading business instead of a service/processing/manufacturing activity.
Missing Round-1 portal deadline without submitting a Principal-attested physical representation to the DCE Nodal Officer.
Not linking an active UPI QR code to claim the ₹100/month automatic cashback.
Ration card e-KYC incomplete or bank account NPCI Aadhaar DBT mapper inactive.
Account ID / RR Number not linked with tenant/owner Aadhaar on Seva Sindhu.
Head of family Aadhaar not linked with Food & Civil Supplies DBT server.
Aadhaar not seeded with NPCI mapper or Face-Auth OTR incomplete on NSP App.
Not submitting the Income Certificate (< ₹4.5L) to the education loan bank to activate CSIS zero-interest moratorium.
Name spelling mismatch between SSLC marksheet and Aadhaar Card.
Forgetting to submit the monthly 1-click self-declaration between the 1st and 25th of each month.
Trying to apply on a home phone—PM Vishwakarma strictly requires CSC operator biometric login.
e-KYC incomplete or Land Seeding marked 'NO' in Revenue/Bhoomi records.
FRUITS Farmer ID (FID) not linked with Caste & Income RD number before applying on Suvarna / Seva Sindhu.
Applying through fake private websites instead of official state nodal portal (KREDL / pmkusum.mnre.gov.in).
Crop name mismatch between RTC Pahani crop survey and bank portal entry.
Missing prompt repayment window, which forfeits the 3% government interest subsidy.
Annual Life Certificate (Jeevan Pramaan) biometric e-KYC not renewed.
Husband's Death Certificate registration number not verified on e-JanMa portal.
Delay in registering pregnancy at Anganwadi beyond 150 days.
Starting foundation work before the Panchayat/Municipal engineer takes the Stage-0 empty-site Geo-Tag photo.
Waiting until a medical emergency instead of pre-downloading the Ayushman Golden Card on beneficiary.nha.gov.in.
statutoryRule: Up to 2 girl students per family with annual household income below ₹8,00,000 are eligible.
₹30,000/kW up to 2 kW + ₹18,000 for 3rd kW (Total ₹78,000 non-repayable grant). Remaining amount available as collateral-free 7% bank loan.
Open to 55+ worker categories (masons, electricians, plumbers, painters, carpenters, earth-movers, helpers) aged 18–60 who worked 90+ days in the past year.
SC/ST/OBC/Women/Minorities get 35% free subsidy in rural areas (25% in urban). No income ceiling! Minimum 8th standard pass for projects above ₹10L.
Note: Round-1 portal closed today; students whose college admission/counselling was delayed can submit a Principal-attested Late Condonation Form for Round-2.
Even vendors without a formal vending certificate can apply via a simple Letter of Recommendation (LoR) generated online from the ULB/Municipality.
Govt Order WCD 2023: Payable to ONE woman head listed on Ration Card. Excluded if woman or husband pays Income Tax or files GST returns.
Applicable to 1 domestic meter per household/Aadhaar (both house owners and rented-house tenants qualify).
Mandatory monthly biometric thumb verification at Fair Price Shop (Ration Depot) + active BPL/Antyodaya card.
NSP OTR Guidelines: Student can hold only ONE Central Sector scholarship at a time. Family income ≤ ₹2.5L.
Family income below ₹4.5 Lakh qualifies for both PM-USP scholarship and 100% education loan interest subsidy via Jansamarth portal.
Karnataka Sakala Act SLA: 21 Working Days. Can be legally stacked with non-conflicting fee concessions.
Candidate must submit monthly self-declaration on Seva Sindhu before the 25th confirming they are not in full-time PF-paying employment.
Open to 18 self-employed trades (tailors, carpenters, masons, mechanics, barbers, goldsmiths, washermen, potters, garland makers). One member per family.
PM-KISAN Para 4: Income Tax payers and regular Govt employees are statutorily excluded.
Farmer must be a small/marginal landholder without an existing working irrigation borewell on that survey number.
MNRE PM-KUSUM Guidelines: 30% Central + 30% State subsidy; farmer pays only 10% upfront (30% bank loan).
Localised calamity/hailstorm loss must be reported within 72 hours on Crop Insurance App or 14447 helpline.
RBI Circular: Banks must waive processing/inspection charges for KCC limits up to ₹3 Lakh and issue decision within 14 days.
Social Security Pension Rules: A citizen can draw only ONE social security pension (Old Age OR Widow) at a time.
Mutually exclusive with Old-Age Pension under NSAP rules; Hakku prevents duplicate pension filing that triggers recovery notices.
Must have MCP (Mother and Child Protection / Thayi) Card registered at local Anganwadi / Primary Health Centre.
Beneficiary family must not own an existing pucca house anywhere in India; female ownership or joint ownership is mandatory.
NHA 2024 Amendment: All senior citizens aged 70+ qualify solely on Aadhaar age proof with ZERO income limit; BPL/priority families covered at all ages.

steps: Step 1: Visit scholarships.gov.in and complete One-Time Registration (OTR) using Aadhaar OTP.
Step 2: Download NSP OTR App on Android and complete Face Authentication.
Step 3: Login to NSP → Click 'Apply for Scholarship' → Choose 'AICTE Pragati Scholarship Scheme for Girl Students'.
Step 4: Upload PDF scans of Income Certificate, Bonafide Letter, and Fee Receipt (each under 200 KB).
Step 5: Submit online and hand 1 printed copy to your College Scholarship Nodal Officer for Institute e-Verification.
Step 1: Go to pmsuryaghar.gov.in and click 'Apply for Rooftop Solar'.
Step 2: Select your State, Electricity Company (BESCOM/HESCOM/etc.), and enter your Consumer Account Number.
Step 3: Receive automatic Technical Feasibility Approval from your DISCOM online.
Step 4: Select a registered vendor on the portal and install the plant.
Step 5: Upload net-meter details and cancelled cheque—₹78,000 subsidy hits your bank account within 30 days.
Step 1: Open karbwwb.karnataka.gov.in or sevasindhuservices.karnataka.gov.in.
Step 2: Register for smart Labour Card using Aadhaar OTP and 90-day work certificate.
Step 3: Once approved, open 'Scheme Benefits' tab → Select Education Assistance (Shikshana Sahayadhana) or Marriage Grant (Vivaha Sahayadhana).
Step 4: Upload supporting receipt and submit for direct DBT transfer.
Step 1: Visit kviconline.gov.in/pmegpeportal and click 'Application for New Unit'.
Step 2: Select Implementing Agency (KVIC / KVIB / DIC) and choose a pre-made Project Profile from the portal library.
Step 3: Upload Aadhaar, Caste Certificate, and Educational Qualification.
Step 4: Complete the free online EDP (Entrepreneurship Development Programme) module after bank sanction to lock in your 35% grant.
Step 1: Check dce.karnataka.gov.in / ssp.postmatric.karnataka.gov.in for Laptop Scheme Notification.
Step 2: Since Round-1 closed today, print the Hakku Application & Condonation Letter from Tab 4.
Step 3: Get it signed by your College Principal and submit to the District Social Welfare / DCE Nodal Desk for Round-2 inclusion.
Step 1: Visit pmsvanidhi.mohua.gov.in and click 'Apply Loan / LoR'.
Step 2: Verify mobile via OTP and select 'Vendor without ID (Request LoR)' if you don't have a street vendor card.
Step 3: Choose your preferred nearby nationalised bank; 7% interest subsidy is credited quarterly via DBT.
Step 1: Book a free slot via Seva Sindhu or walk into your nearest GramaOne / KarnatakaOne / Bapuji Seva Kendra.
Step 2: Provide Ration Card number and complete biometric thumb/OTP authentication.
Step 3: Collect the printed Acknowledgement Slip (₹0 official government fee).
Step 1: Visit sevasindhuservices.karnataka.gov.in → Click 'Gruha Jyothi Scheme' (No login required).
Step 2: Select your ESCOM (BESCOM/HESCOM/etc.) and enter your 10-digit Account ID from your bill.
Step 3: Verify your Aadhaar via OTP—your next month's bill will automatically show ₹0.
Step 1: No separate application needed if your BPL card is active and e-KYC is done at your Ration Depot.
Step 2: To check if your cash is stuck, open ahara.kar.nic.in → E-Services → E-Status → DBT Status.
Step 3: If DBT shows failed, submit the Hakku NPCI Bank Mandate Form at your bank.
Step 1: Generate One-Time Registration (OTR) ID on scholarships.gov.in.
Step 2: Complete Face-Auth on the NSP Mobile App.
Step 3: Select Post-Matric Scholarship, enter RD numbers for Income/Caste, and submit.
Step 1: For the ₹12k–₹20k cash scholarship, apply on scholarships.gov.in under 'Department of Higher Education'.
Step 2: For the 100% Education Loan Interest Subsidy (CSIS), visit jansamarth.in → Education Loan → Check Subsidy Eligibility.
Step 1: Open ssp.postmatric.karnataka.gov.in and login with your SSP ID.
Step 2: Enter your Nadakacheri RD Number and College Registration Number.
Step 3: Complete e-Attestation if in degree/engineering and submit.
Step 1: Login to sevasindhuservices.karnataka.gov.in and search 'Yuva Nidhi'.
Step 2: Enter your University Registration Number for automatic NAD verification.
Step 3: Every month before the 25th, click 'Yuva Nidhi Self-Declaration' so your ₹3,000 does not pause.
Step 1: Carry your Aadhaar, Ration Card, and Bank Passbook to the nearest Common Service Centre (CSC).
Step 2: Complete biometric fingerprint authentication on pmvishwakarma.gov.in (₹0 registration cost—government pays the CSC).
Step 3: Attend the 5-day local skill verification to receive ₹2,500 cash stipend + ₹15,000 e-RUPI toolkit voucher.
Step 1: Open pmkisan.gov.in → Click 'New Farmer Registration' or 'e-KYC'.
Step 2: Enter Aadhaar number and FRUITS / Land Survey RTC details.
Step 3: Check 'Know Your Status' to confirm Land Seeding = YES and Aadhaar Bank Seeding = YES.
Step 1: Obtain your 16-digit FRUITS ID at your local Raitha Samparka Kendra.
Step 2: Visit sevasindhuservices.karnataka.gov.in → Search 'Ganga Kalyana Scheme'.
Step 3: Enter FRUITS ID and Nadakacheri RD Number to auto-fetch land records and submit.
Step 1: Visit pmkusum.mnre.gov.in or souramitra.com (KREDL Karnataka portal).
Step 2: Register with FRUITS ID and select pump capacity (3 HP to 10 HP).
Step 3: Pay only your beneficiary share after official work order is issued.
Step 1: Visit pmfby.gov.in or samrakshane.karnataka.gov.in before the seasonal cutoff.
Step 2: Enter Survey Number and select insured crop.
Step 3: Pay the nominal 1.5%–2% farmer share and download the Policy Certificate.
Step 1: Download the 1-page PM-KISAN KCC form from pmkisan.gov.in.
Step 2: Submit at the bank branch where your PM-KISAN installment is credited.
Step 3: Under RBI rules, the bank must process it within 14 working days with ₹0 processing fee.
Step 1: Visit Nadakacheri / GramaOne or apply on sevasindhu.karnataka.gov.in.
Step 2: Village Accountant completes field verification within 21 Sakala working days.
Step 3: Pension starts crediting every month via India Post Payments Bank or NPCI Bank Account.
Step 1: Apply at Nadakacheri / GramaOne with Aadhaar and Husband's Death Certificate.
Step 2: Track status using your 15-digit Nadakacheri Ack Number.

Step 1: Visit pmmvy.wcd.gov.in and click 'Citizen Login' using your mobile number.
Step 2: Enter your MCP Card details and upload Aadhaar + Bank Passbook.
Step 3: Alternatively, hand the documents to your local ASHA / Anganwadi worker for free entry.
Step 1: For Urban, apply directly on pmaymis.gov.in under PMAY-U 2.0 Citizen Survey.
Step 2: For Rural, submit application at your Gram Panchayat under PMAY-G / Basava Vasathi Yojana.
Step 3: Ensure Stage-0 Geo-Tagging is done before laying the foundation so your 1st installment releases smoothly.
Step 1: Open beneficiary.nha.gov.in on your phone or download the 'Ayushman App'.
Step 2: Login as Beneficiary using your mobile OTP.
Step 3: Click the '70+ Senior Citizen Enrollment' banner (or search by Ration Card), complete Aadhaar OTP e-KYC, and download your ₹5 Lakh card in 3 minutes.

Family annual income from all sources must be less than ₹8,00,000.
Maximum 2 girls per family can claim this ₹50,000/year grant.
Indian citizen with an electricity meter connection in their name.
House roof suitable for 1 kW to 3 kW solar panel installation.
Must not have claimed an earlier MNRE rooftop solar subsidy.
Age between 18 and 60 years working in construction, plumbing, painting, electrical, carpentry, or allied daily-wage work.
90-day employment certificate from contractor, Gram Panchayat PDO, or registered union.
Must hold an active KBOCWWB / State Labour Welfare Board ID card.
Any individual aged 18+ years starting a new micro-enterprise or service unit.
No family income ceiling applies under PMEGP rules.
Special category (Women, OBC, SC, ST, Minorities, Ex-Servicemen) receives maximum 35% rural / 25% urban grant.
Must be enrolled in 1st-year Government or Govt-Quota seat in Degree, Engineering, Medical, or Polytechnic.
Annual family income ≤ ₹2,50,000 (SC/ST/OBC/EWS priority).

Any street vendor, hawker, home-food seller, cobbler, vegetable cart, or small service kiosk operator.

Any residential electricity connection consuming under 200 units/month.
Both homeowners and tenants (using rental agreement/voter ID) can register.
One meter per Aadhaar card.
Must hold an active Antyodaya Anna Yojana (AAY) or Priority Household (BPL) Ration Card.

Studying in Class 11, 12, Diploma, UG, PG, or Ph.D. in a recognized institution.

All farmers (both loanee and non-loanee) growing notified Kharif/Rabi crops.

Owner cultivator, tenant farmer, dairy farmer, or poultry/fishery farmer aged 18–75.
